svg.title: Split range: one controller, a heater and a cooler
svg.desc: With 60 kilowatts entering the jacket, the split range switches from heating to cooling in one update at 0.3 seconds and settles with the cooler at 30 percent, minus 30 kilowatts, holding the vessel at 35 degrees Celsius; the heater-only cascade can only switch off and its vessel rises to 48.28 degrees. With a 30 kilowatt jacket loss the heater settles at 30 percent, plus 60 kilowatts.
svg.text: Split range: one controller, a heater and a cooler
Control Studio recording of this project · 60 kW into the jacket, or a 30 kW jacket loss, from 35 °C · numbers answer the predictions
Heater 30 % = +60 kW in the loss test
At 0.3 s the heater went to 0 % as the cooler came on;
Loss test: heater 30 %, vessel at least 34.80 °C
